title: CobbleBeta
description: This modpack combines Cobblemon with Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 to create a nostalgic Pokémon survival experience, featuring classic terrain generation, old-school gameplay mechanics, and a simplified modded environment.
body:
**Discord Server**

https://discord.gg/7Hr9qG2QVk (Sneak Peeks for future updates will be shown here!)

**About the modpack**

This modpack aims to combine Cobblemon with the Beta versions of Minecraft _(Specifically Beta 1.7.3)_ this is _**VERY**_ early in development

**What does the modpack add?**

This modpack obviously includes **Cobblemon** but it also includes a few other mods like **Moderner Beta** for world generation, **Nostalgic Tweaks** that brings back classic mechanics like removing hunger and sprint and even adding sword blocking and many more, there's also **Just Enough Items** so you can see all the items and blocks that are in the game, as well as your typical performance mods such as **Sodium**

**What textures have been changed, and who made them?**

Most of the textures have not been modified yet, currently only the Poké Balls, Evolution Stone Ores, all the wood stuff and the Relic Coin item have been changed

The Poké Balls and Evolution Stone Ores are made by **Mole Co.** while the rest of the textures are made by me, **Willabuilder2**

**Known Bugs**

Saccharine Trees are super rare

NOTE: Saccharine Trees do in fact generate but only in the moderner_beta:taiga biome (which is always snowy)

**The Future**

I want to change most if not all of the items and blocks from Cobblemon however i do not plan on retexturing the Pokémon themselves if someone wants to make them in a resource pack or a mod i would gladly add it to the modpack, I also want to add some other mods as well.
**_Maybe_** I might add The Aether or some other old iconic mods
